info.name: JSAN GeoSales 360 API
info.description:
Postman collection for the JSAN GeoSales 360 backend API (FastAPI). Covers authentication and every Salesforce-backed CRM/GIS endpoint mounted under /salesforce, grouped by resource.

Run "Auth > Login" first - its Tests script stores the returned access_token into the {{token}} collection variable, which the collection-level Bearer auth then applies automatically to every other request.

request.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT bearer token. The Tests script below stores the returned access_token into the {{token}} collection variable so every other request in this collection is automatically authenticated afterwards.

request.description: Runs the boundary-based auto-assignment that maps Accounts, Leads and Discovery Candidates to territories using their GIS coordinates. Takes no request body.
Recomputes/nudges record coordinates so they fall within their assigned territory's real boundary/direction. Takes no request body.
